data.title: Learn anything *at your level*
data.subtitle: Good at #1: explaining, with as many follow-ups as you need.

items: The topic, in your own words
Why you need it: a meeting, a letter, a course

blocks.text: Explain how [topic] works. I'm a complete beginner. Use one everyday comparison and one short example, then ask me one question to check I've understood.

blocks.new: Explain inflation to a beginner with a shopping example, then quiz me.

blocks.text: Wrong answer? Ask it to **explain it a different way**.

items: "Give me a real example from my job: [job]."
"What do people usually get wrong about this?"
Facts that matter: check a second source
Numbers and dates: ask where they come from
